thread.title: Apple, Oprah: Winfrey in multiyear original-content deal - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Jason Aycock
title: Apple, Oprah: Winfrey in multiyear original-content deal - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Apple's ( AAPL -1% ) latest original-content deal is with Oprah Winfrey , who will create programs for the tech giant in a multiyear arrangement.
That will entail a number of programs and Winfrey is expected to have on- and off-camera roles, though the extent to which she'd star in the programming is still unknown.
"Together, Winfrey and Apple will create original programs that embrace her incomparable ability to connect with audiences around the world," Apple says.
The deal doesn't affect Winfrey's contract with OWN, where she recently extended her contract through 2025.
